_help: Email, phone, WhatsApp, location and social links. Used in the Contact section, mobile menu and footer. 'phones' lists your WhatsApp numbers in international format, e.g. +234 801 234 5678; each one becomes a WhatsApp link. Anything in [square brackets] is a placeholder — the site shows it as plain text (no link) until you replace it. Social icons stay hidden until they have a full https:// link.
